outcome.answer: Yes — the closest match is [2], which surveys code as an agent harness and explicitly centers code as the basis for agent infrastructure, including reasoning, action, planning, memory, and tool use. [2] It is broader than a review of programmable scripts specifically, but it does cover the role of executable code as the operational substrate for agent reasoning and execution, and [3] similarly frames reusable procedural artifacts as the operational layer for agent execution. [1] focuses more narrowly on programmatic tool calling versus JSON tool calling, while [7] emphasizes procedural skills for research agents rather than a general review of scripts as the core structure.
